recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. The accepted clarification is present in authoritative current source; any future operation, query parameter, or header to force native retrieval of FHIR-typed Binary content should be handled as a new feature request.
issue_request: FHIR-13507 was a Published/Persuasive, non-substantive STU3 FHIR-core Binary issue. It requested clearer behavior when Binary content itself is application/fhir+xml or application/fhir+json: explicit FHIR MIME Accept requests return the Binary resource wrapper in the requested FHIR format, the rule is not for generic XML/JSON requests, and _format overrides Accept as a standard FHIR MIME request even when a generic value is supplied.
initial_application: The issue was applied in svn revision 14354, represented by git commit 4c0d34042c3e8742eda89fdb336da09c622aa009, together with FHIR-16886. That commit rewrote source/binary/binary-notes.xml into list-based REST guidance and added the explicit FHIR Accept, _format override, non-FHIR Accept, generic MIME, and create/update Binary behavior that still carries the decision.
additional_context: Binary is an active current-build resource in source/fhir.ini and part of the infrastructure normative package. Adjacent and later Binary REST issues (FHIR-16886, FHIR-17026, FHIR-17027, FHIR-18338, FHIR-32955, FHIR-37381, and FHIR-19254) restructure, normalize, de-duplicate, or decline tooling-related changes without reversing FHIR-13507. Community searches found no conflicting Zulip or Confluence evidence.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The combined branch source already says a read request with a FHIR type in Accept returns the Binary resource in the requested FHIR format even when Binary.data itself has a FHIR MIME type, that _format overrides Accept and is interpreted as standard FHIR MIME types, and that generic MIME handling remains separate.
